controls_and_negative_evidence: Both target tables have ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY and SELECT-only explicit grants in target migration.
Both policies include clinic_id IN current_clinic_ids(); helper is membership/clinic-scoped, so this finding does not establish cross-tenant read.
Two-clinic test currently covers patient, patient_summary and clinic_location but not target tables.
Role test covers clinical_record and clinical_form_response (plus patient for reception) but not target tables.
Migration role-boundary description scopes its allow/deny rule to clinical_record and clinical_form_response; it is not evidence of role approval for all operational PII.
Invoice projection has a separate clinic-scoped use of patient email/contact data and must be regression-tested if access is narrowed.

Target-name search across all supabase/migrations found no later explicit GRANT/REVOKE/policy change for either table; 20260802000002 repairs service_role privileges only. This static search does not establish the final effective ACL in a running database.
Repository migrations search found no GRANT/REVOKE ON ALL TABLES; the later ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES statement changes function EXECUTE defaults, not table SELECT privileges.
